# AirFrameXR: games and mods known to obey the FOV restriction (shipped with the program, replaced by an update: do not edit this file).
# Add your own in fov_restriction_whitelist.txt next to it; start a line there with - to stop trusting an entry of this file (-UEVRBackend.dll).
# A trusted game is told the restricted box ("Try to apply FOV restriction") at its FIRST start; it is still checked on that start, and a game that does not follow the
# box goes back to the whole view and stays there. Games not listed are told the whole view at their first start and get the restriction from their next start
# only if they followed the box.
# One entry per line: a DLL name (a mod loaded into the game: the game is trusted when that module is in its process) or a game executable.
# Case does not matter; '#' starts a comment.
